# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file. The format follows
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and the project uses
[Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

### Fixed

- A change that is not released yet.

## [1.2.0] - 2026-10-20

### Added

- A one-step Windows installer, `RootMind-Setup-x64.exe`, with a built-in backend.
- An optional background service for Windows.

### Changed

- `rootmind api` now uses `api.host` and `api.port` from `config.yaml`.

## [1.2.0-rc.1] - 2026-10-15

### Added

- A release candidate of the installer.
